network.description:
The network on which the queried stake accounts have been created . Supported values;
- mainnet
- testnet
- devnet

participant.description: The participant name registered on the staking platform from which stake accounts need to be retrieved.

account.description: The account name registered on the staking platform from which stake accounts need to be retrieved.

status.description:
The status of the stake accounts that need to be retrieved. Results will be returned in the order of the statuses sent in the request. Supported values;
- ACTIVE
- INACTIVE
- ACTIVATING
- DEACTIVATING

stake_accounts.description: List of delegator stake accounts to fetch the delegator information. A maximum of 250 entries are allowed.

items.description: List of delegator stake accounts to fetch the delegator information. A maximum of 250 entries are allowed.
